verdict.rationale: A probe confirms GitHub publishes an official CLI at cli.github.com, so the vendor ships a first-party command-line tool. The evidence is a single thin probe: it does not show that the CLI covers Projects operations such as items, fields or views, nor how it serves AI-native or agent workflows. Missing for 10: documentation of Projects-specific CLI commands, evidence of agent or scripting-oriented CLI usage, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
